Full enumeration is needed to deactivate every noncandidate leaf for isolated rendering; an incomplete list is unsafe.
new_behavior: Full-context collection is separate from bounded candidate work. Noncandidate objects stay in the original source render and visibility state snapshot. Unsupported objects are separated from resources, geometric failures, visibility failures and member decisions. Candidate budget leftovers are NOT_EVALUATED. budget_basis: Measured real maximum 6249 objects. 32768 bounds cheap wrappers/list at about 2 MiB shallow Python storage, not all native PDF memory. memory_scope: Shallow wrapper/list bytes exclude nested Python dictionaries/helpers and PDFium native allocations. They are observations, not a total-process memory bound. Object counts, recursion, shortlist sizes and detached pixel arrays are separately bounded.
